method: Bounded anonymous diagnostics for the non-eGranthalaya follow-up: one robots.txt read per origin with the app's user agent and robots parser, and at most a few single page reads per host to classify a failure. No retries around a refusal, captcha, login or robots rule. These observations are not book checks and never count as passes or as absence. Shared-host stops are recorded in the result files as not_attempted.

hosts.alsoUsedAs: Alternate route for 28 entries; preferred search route for indcat:indcat-cali-673635, indcat:indcat-kanu-670567, indcat:indcat-krla-695034, indcat:indcat-mgnd-686560 and indcat:indcat-nals-682017, which fall back to IndCat.
observations: robots.txt: no response within 10 s (11:13Z); the app policy then allows requests for five minutes.
A proxied TLS connection to /robots.txt was reset by the peer after 3.3 s, before any HTTP response (egress relay: 517 bytes sent, 39 received).
App search for three members (history, india): fetch failed six times; the run stopped the host after three successive members (vufind-results.json).

The app's KALNET transport supplies its own TLS agent (for the catalog's missing intermediate certificate), so in this environment it does not use the execution proxy. A proxied request also failed, so the catalog was not reached by either path.
The earlier run recorded robots.txt HTTP 503 at 07:49Z.
Second check at 12:23Z: robots.txt again gave no response within 10 s.

robots.txt and the first search both answered HTTP 403 from CloudFront: 'Request blocked. We can't connect to the server for this app or website at this time' (x-cache: Error from cloudfront, edge POP IAD55).
The app classifies 403 as a refusal; no further requests were sent. The block was observed from a United States edge; whether Indian readers or the production deployment are blocked is not known.
The earlier broad run stopped this host after three successive discovery errors (HTTP 503), not a policy refusal; 192 members were never attempted.

11:23Z app search (agriculture, AAUA scope): HTTP 503 after 14 s. The 503 body was the execution egress proxy's 'upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers ... remote connection failure', not a catalog page.
robots.txt: no response within 10 s at 11:13Z; HTTP 503 at 11:42Z and again at 12:23Z.
hosts.affectedIds: All 195 koha:ideal-* entries; see koha-broad-results.json for the three attempted and 192 not attempted.

observations: The earlier broad run stopped after three successive discovery errors: an unscoped union search followed by member-ownership reads exhausted the 30 s Koha budget (CATALOG_UNRECOGNIZED or deadline).
robots.txt: no response within 30 s, and again no response within 10 s at 12:23Z.
A branch-limited search (limit=branch:CCL) answered HTTP 410 Gone from Apache after 25 s. The directory already searches this union unscoped; the restriction was not worked around.
The same unscoped keyword search the app uses answered HTTP 200 only after 35.5 s, beyond the app's 30 s Koha budget.
hosts.affectedIds: koha:goa-dhe-* (38 entries). One member, koha:goa-dhe-cescaccs, passed in the earlier run; 33 were never attempted and four failed.

observations: robots.txt (HTTP 200) disallows /cgi-bin/koha/opac-search.pl and record views for all agents. Confirmed again at 11:13Z; no catalog request sent.
